title: Map set 2: name the marked place

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Guru Shikhar (Rajasthan) is the marked place. Highest point of the Aravallis, on Mount Abu. The others: Nanda Devi is in Uttarakhand; Saramati is in Nagaland; Kangchenjunga is in Sikkim.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Dhanushkodi (Tamil Nadu) is the marked place. Tip of Rameswaram island facing Sri Lanka; Ram Setu. The others: Kochi Port is in Kerala; Jog Falls is in Karnataka; Sardar Sarovar Dam is in Gujarat.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Mundra Port (Gujarat) is the marked place. Large private port in the Gulf of Kutch. The others: Vizhinjam Port is in Kerala; Visakhapatnam Port is in Andhra Pradesh; New Mangalore Port is in Karnataka.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Nal Sarovar (Gujarat) is the marked place. Bird sanctuary west of Ahmedabad; Ramsar site. The others: Deepor Beel is in Assam; Harike Wetland is in Punjab; Hokersar Wetland is in Jammu & Kashmir.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Mahendragiri (Odisha) is the marked place. Highest peak of the Eastern Ghats in Odisha. The others: Kangchenjunga is in Sikkim; Anamudi is in Kerala; Dhupgarh is in Madhya Pradesh.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: New Mangalore Port (Karnataka) is the marked place. Kudremukh ore and coffee exports. The others: Kandla (Deendayal Port) is in Gujarat; V.O. Chidambaranar Port (Tuticorin) is in Tamil Nadu; Jawaharlal Nehru Port (Nhava Sheva) is in Maharashtra.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Great Himalayan National Park (Himachal Pradesh) is the marked place. World Heritage Site in Kullu district. The others: Dachigam National Park is in Jammu & Kashmir; Eravikulam National Park is in Kerala; Desert National Park is in Rajasthan.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Idukki Dam (Kerala) is the marked place. Arch dam on the Periyar. The others: Hirakud Dam is in Odisha; Sardar Sarovar Dam is in Gujarat; Tungabhadra Dam is in Karnataka.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Lipulekh Pass (Uttarakhand) is the marked place. Tri-junction of India, Nepal and China; Kailash–Mansarovar route. The others: Khardung La is in Ladakh; Zoji La is in Ladakh; Thal Ghat is in Maharashtra.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: V.O. Chidambaranar Port (Tuticorin) (Tamil Nadu) is the marked place. Gulf of Mannar port in Thoothukudi. The others: Mundra Port is in Gujarat; Mormugao Port is in Goa; Paradip Port is in Odisha.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Wular Lake (Jammu & Kashmir) is the marked place. Largest freshwater lake in India; the Jhelum flows through it. The others: Tso Moriri is in Ladakh; Ashtamudi Lake is in Kerala; Chilika Lake is in Odisha.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Kulasekarapattinam (Tamil Nadu) is the marked place. ISRO's second spaceport, for small satellite launchers. The others: Khardung La is in Ladakh; Gangotri Glacier is in Uttarakhand; Dachigam National Park is in Jammu & Kashmir.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
o: Marine National Park, Gulf of Kutch
questions.e: Manas National Park (Assam) is the marked place. On the Bhutan border; World Heritage Site; pygmy hog, golden langur. The others: Bhitarkanika National Park is in Odisha; Namdapha National Park is in Arunachal Pradesh; Marine National Park, Gulf of Kutch is in Gujarat.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Vizhinjam Port (Kerala) is the marked place. Deep-water transhipment port near Thiruvananthapuram. The others: Visakhapatnam Port is in Andhra Pradesh; New Mangalore Port is in Karnataka; Kandla (Deendayal Port) is in Gujarat.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Khardung La (Ladakh) is the marked place. Road from Leh to the Nubra valley. The others: Bhor Ghat is in Maharashtra; Thal Ghat is in Maharashtra; Lipulekh Pass is in Uttarakhand.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Prayagraj (Sangam) (Uttar Pradesh) is the marked place. Ganga meets the Yamuna; Kumbh Mela. The others: Hampi is in Karnataka; Nanda Devi is in Uttarakhand; Athirappilly Falls is in Kerala.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Rann of Kutch (Gujarat) is the marked place. Seasonal salt marsh; wild ass sanctuary in the Little Rann. The others: Bhoj Wetland is in Madhya Pradesh; Athirappilly Falls is in Kerala; Doddabetta is in Tamil Nadu.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Thal Ghat (Maharashtra) is the marked place. Mumbai–Nashik road and rail route across the Western Ghats. The others: Bom Di La is in Arunachal Pradesh; Khardung La is in Ladakh; Rohtang Pass is in Himachal Pradesh.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Sambhar Lake (Rajasthan) is the marked place. Largest inland salt lake in India; flamingos. The others: Kolleru Lake is in Andhra Pradesh; Vembanad Lake is in Kerala; Bhoj Wetland is in Madhya Pradesh.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Nagarjunsagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve (Andhra Pradesh) is the marked place. India's largest tiger reserve, along the Krishna. The others: Melghat Tiger Reserve is in Maharashtra; Periyar Tiger Reserve is in Kerala; Valmiki Tiger Reserve is in Bihar.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Zoji La (Ladakh) is the marked place. Links Srinagar with Leh; Zojila tunnel under construction. The others: Bom Di La is in Arunachal Pradesh; Palghat Gap is in Kerala / Tamil Nadu; Thal Ghat is in Maharashtra.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Bodh Gaya (Bihar) is the marked place. Mahabodhi temple, where the Buddha attained enlightenment. The others: Kalinga (Dhauli) is in Odisha; Rakhigarhi is in Haryana; Lothal is in Gujarat.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
o: Marine National Park, Gulf of Kutch
questions.e: Silent Valley National Park (Kerala) is the marked place. Tropical evergreen forest; lion-tailed macaque. The others: Marine National Park, Gulf of Kutch is in Gujarat; Hemis National Park is in Ladakh; Namdapha National Park is in Arunachal Pradesh.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Hokersar Wetland (Jammu & Kashmir) is the marked place. Migratory bird reserve near Srinagar; Ramsar site. The others: Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve is in Tamil Nadu; Rohtang Pass is in Himachal Pradesh; Mahendragiri is in Odisha.

questions.q: Which of the following is marked on the map?
questions.e: Hampi (Karnataka) is the marked place. Capital of the Vijayanagara empire on the Tungabhadra. The others: Khajuraho is in Madhya Pradesh; Kalinga (Dhauli) is in Odisha; Ajanta Caves is in Maharashtra.
